Canada will play the first leg away with venue and opponent to be confirmed following the conclusion of the group stage this October. Canada earned a bye directly into the Quarterfinals as one of the region's four top-ranked nations, alongside Mexico, the United States and Panama, after finishing third in the 2024-25 Concacaf Nations League. The Quarterfinals will be played as a two-legged, home-and-away series decided on aggregate goals. The four series winners will advance to the Concacaf Nations League Finals at SoFi Stadium in Los Angeles in March 2027 and qualify directly for the 2027 Concacaf Gold Cup. The four losing teams will advance to the Gold Cup preliminary round. Nations League History Canada has reached the Concacaf Nations League Finals in two of the last three editions, finishing as runner-up in 2022-23 and claiming third place in 2024-25.
